WITH robot_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        rr.recreg AS robot_id,
        -- Average tool usage severity from performance_and_safety
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(ps.conditionindexval) AS numeric), 4) AS avg_tool_severity,
        -- TPC from operation
        SUM(op.progcyclecount) AS tpc,
        -- Average cycle time from operation
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(op.cycletimesecval) AS numeric), 2) AS avg_cycle_time,
        -- Sum of tool wear from performance_and_safety
        SUM(ps.toolwearpct) AS sum_tool_wear
    FROM robot_record rr
    JOIN robot_details rd ON rr.recreg = rd.botdetreg
    JOIN operation op ON rd.botdetreg = op.operbotdetref
    JOIN performance_and_safety ps ON rd.botdetreg = ps.effectivenessrobot
    GROUP BY rr.recreg
)
